note: Task inventory updated after reliability fixes (analytics SQLite, webqa fallback, session timeout, CORS). Three code-quality improvements pending.

summary.goal: Deliver a stable Gainesville RTS backend with realtime bus info, schedule support, and a user-facing web assistant/dashboard.

tasks.title: Set up Flask backend application and deployment entrypoints
tasks.details: Created app factory, server entrypoint, and static file hosting for web UI pages.

tasks.title: Implement RTS BusTime API integration routes
tasks.details: Backend exposes realtime routes/predictions endpoints through route blueprints and service modules.

tasks.title: Add health endpoint with cache/session status checks
tasks.details: Health endpoint reports service status, BusTime reachability, backend basics availability, and cache/session stats.

tasks.title: Create main tracker UI, chat page, and wizard page
tasks.details: Static pages in public_html include main interface, standalone chat, and wizard workflow.

tasks.title: Integrate AI assistant API and web indexing endpoints
tasks.details: Added agent and web indexing/search/ask endpoints for assistant functionality.

tasks.title: Prepare Render deployment configuration and docs
tasks.details: Repository includes render.yaml, README, deployment notes, SOP, and implementation summary docs.

tasks.title: Add project task dashboard page and task API
tasks.details: Dashboard page reads task status from JSON and shows completed/pending/blocked counts.

tasks.title: Reliability and data persistence improvements
tasks.details: Analytics log migrated from ephemeral JSON-lines file to SQLite (survives Render redeploys). webqa.py now has go-rts.com as fallback and only locks the index when pages actually cached. Session timeout extended from 5 to 30 minutes. CORS reads from CORS_ORIGINS env var.

tasks.title: Split agent_service.py into focused modules
tasks.details: agent_service.py is ~1500 lines handling regex extraction, LLM intent parsing, cache, stop resolution, fallback chains, language detection, and button generation. Split into: intent_extractor.py, stop_resolver.py, response_builder.py, and a thin orchestrator.

tasks.title: Replace keyword overlap in webqa.py with OpenAI embeddings
tasks.details: Current token-overlap scoring misses synonyms and context. Replace with text-embedding-3-small vector similarity search. Data is small enough to embed entirely in memory on startup.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for parse_date, parse_time, and intent extraction
tasks.details: schedule_service.parse_date and parse_time handle many edge cases (weekdays, tomorrow, 12am/pm, etc.) with no test coverage. agent_service intent extraction is similarly untested. A small pytest suite would catch regressions.

tasks.title: Fix XSS: escape API answer before innerHTML in wizard.js
tasks.details: fetchSchedule places the raw LLM answer string directly into innerHTML. Add escapeHtml() and escape the answer before DOM insertion; apply styleExceptionNotes and fallback note after escaping.

tasks.title: Remove disabled chat panel from wizard.html
tasks.details: wizard.html has a grayed-out chat section below the working wizard. It signals 'broken' rather than 'coming soon'. Remove it; chat being in development phase is already communicated on /chat.

tasks.title: Show route names in wizard route selection buttons
tasks.details: renderStepRoute shows only route numbers. /api/routes already returns r.name (e.g. 'Rosa Parks to Butler Plaza TS'). Display it so riders know which route to pick.

tasks.title: Add route filter input to wizard route selection step
tasks.details: With 20+ routes as buttons, mobile users have to scroll through a wall of options. Add a search/filter input above the route grid to narrow down by number or name.

tasks.title: Fix index.html assistant button to point to /wizard instead of /chat
tasks.details: index.html:134 has 'Open RTS Assistant' linking to /chat, which is disabled. Points users to a dead-end. Change href to /wizard.

tasks.title: Keep task inventory updated after each change
tasks.details: Review and update TASKS.md and project_tasks.json whenever a feature is finished or scope changes.

tasks.title: Add/expand automated tests for routes and services
tasks.details: Add unit/integration tests for API routes, service behavior, and edge cases before major rollout.

tasks.title: Protect admin/project dashboard endpoints if needed
tasks.details: Decide whether /dashboard and project status APIs should be public or require a token/auth guard.

tasks.title: Add error logging and production monitoring improvements
tasks.details: Centralize structured logs and alerting for API failures, timeouts, and dependency outages.

tasks.title: Define repeatable GTFS/schedule data refresh workflow
tasks.details: Document and automate schedule ingest/rebuild process for semester/service changes.

tasks.title: Realtime reliability depends on external RTS BusTime API uptime
tasks.details: Intermittent provider/API outages can degrade predictions; mitigation is caching and fallback messaging.

tasks.title: Finalize acceptance criteria for production-ready completion
tasks.details: Need final definition of done (features, QA, uptime, security, and stakeholder signoff) to close the project.

tasks.title: Run pre-release validation on Render deployment
tasks.details: Verify health endpoint, main UI, chat, wizard, schedule flows, and dashboard after deploy.
